content.comment_body: Hello, I am having trouble activating the web server on my [product_name]. I can connect to the device over the network using [product_name] software (connection tests are successful), but I am unable to change parameters online. When I try to access the generic web server with my browser, I see the default device representation, but my custom page is not accessible. Uploading and downloading programs works fine. What steps should I take to resolve this? --- Split from Weekly timers on [product_name].

Closed because the question was posted twice. The second thread with the subject 'Can't activate the web server' is published within the [product_name] - Software conference. Best regards, [user_name]_Moderator

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing issues activating the web server feature on a [company_name] [product_name] device while using [product_name] software. The built-in web server is reachable, but custom web pages cannot be displayed or activated. Connectivity and program transfers are working, indicating the problem lies specifically in the custom web server configuration or activation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants to activate and display custom web pages on the [product_name] web server using both [product_name] software and a web browser, seeking intuitive control over these capabilities.
